comments.author: Hooshu
comments.body_html:
You said elsewhere that com.epicrangetime.shaders isn’t required, but the code says otherwise. Program.cs lists it under ModDependencies:

{ “com.epicrangetime.shaders”, new Range(“~1.0.1“) }

Anything in ModDependencies is a hard dependency in SPT. The server won’t load Un-Practical Tactical unless that mod is installed and in the 1.0.1 range. If it were optional it wouldn’t be in that dictionary at all.
